lines.zh: 我把身边的铁块拖过来。
lines.en: I drag the iron around me.

lines.zh: 我的身体一格格拼起来。
lines.en: My body assembles itself piece by piece.
I shift across the ground.
I favor anything magnetic.

lines.zh: 我绕过石堆，铁片跟着飞。
lines.en: I pass the rubble and iron plates follow.
I shift slowly your way.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边吸附碎块。
lines.en: I pick up debris as I go.

lines.zh: 我的身体每步都响一下。
lines.en: My body clanks with every step.

lines.zh: 我把挡路的铁砧拖进来。
lines.en: I drag an anvil into myself.

lines.zh: 我贴着洞壁滑，铁屑一路掉。
lines.en: I slide along the cave wall, shedding iron dust.
I stop, then lift one foot.
I turn my front slowly.
I hover as iron pieces orbit me.
My core glows faintly.
I am sensing which iron is nearer.
I hold still while everything around moves.
Sparks rise from my seams.
I pull nails from the wall.
I slowly rebuild one arm.

lines.zh: 我的石块在我身边浮着。
lines.en: Stones float beside me.
I wait for more material.
My eyes are two red points.

lines.zh: 我歪着脑袋，打量你的靴扣。
lines.en: I tilt my head at the buckles on your boots.

lines.zh: 我在看你身上有没有铁。
lines.en: I am checking you for iron.
I raise one iron hand.
Your armor interests me.

lines.zh: 我把脸凑近，停在两格之外。
lines.en: I bring my face close and stop two blocks out.

lines.zh: 核心转了一圈，对准了你。
lines.en: My core rotates to face you.
I draw debris onto myself.
I am calculating your weight.
I make no voice, only a hum.
I tilt my head slowly.
A corner of my shell falls away.
I step back and reassemble.

lines.zh: 核心抖了一下，红光乱闪。
lines.en: My core shudders and its red light stutters.
I give off a burst of static.
Several fragments scatter.
I slowly close my body.
My hum drops.
One arm comes loose.
I make not a sound.
I pull the pieces back in.
That iron is not enough for me.
I pull it toward me.

lines.zh: 我围着它转了整整一圈。
lines.en: I circle it completely.

lines.zh: 这块铁我留下，正好补肩。
lines.en: I keep this iron; it fits my shoulder.
It sticks to my shell.
I have no use for these.
I send it right back to you.
I glance and ignore it.
I prefer your armor.
It is too small to patch me.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，铁片飞了出去。
lines.en: You hit me and plates fly off.
You can hardly move me.
My shell shoves you aside.
You are knocked back four blocks.

lines.zh: 我们撞出一声金属长响。
lines.en: We make a long metal clang.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把飞出去的片吸回来。
lines.en: I pull the fallen plates back.
Your blade slides off my shell.
I tip my head down at you.

lines.zh: 你撞得铁片乱响，我半步没让。
lines.en: You clang into me and I give not half a step.

lines.zh: 我身上的碎块掉了两块。
lines.en: Two chunks fall off me.
Two machines face each other.
Our iron pieces pull at each other.

lines.zh: 我们一起把一块巨石拼上。
lines.en: We fit a boulder into place together.
Its core nears mine.
We rise together.

lines.zh: 两台机兵把碎块推来推去。
lines.en: Two constructors shove blocks back and forth.
Neither of us retreats.
Our plates mingle.

lines.zh: 我们的铁片一起朝同一侧。
lines.en: Our plates all swing to one side.

lines.zh: 它们的嗡嗡声合在一处。
lines.en: Their hums join.
I draw the iron into my hand.
I set it into my body.
I squeeze and it deforms.
I carry it half a block.
I flatten it and stow it.
I watch it crack.

lines.zh: 吸过来一看没用，我又丢回去。
lines.en: I pull it in, find it useless, and drop it again.
I fit it onto my shoulder.
I draw it before my chest.
I let go and it drops.
My core suddenly brightens.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味，我已经闻到了。
lines.en: I have caught the smell of iron on you.

lines.zh: 我把整个正面都朝你转过来。
lines.en: I swing my whole front face toward you.
I begin gathering more iron.
All my fragments face forward.
I am no longer hovering still.
I begin pressing your way.

lines.zh: 两点红光钉在你的胸口上。
lines.en: Two red points fix on your chest.
I raise an iron arm.
This place is mine to harvest.
You count as material now.

lines.zh: 我踩碎脚边的石，一路向前。
lines.en: I crush the stones underfoot as I come on.
My hum grows louder.
I set my foot down.
I begin picking up speed.
My shell is fully assembled.

lines.zh: 你绕柱子，我就从另一头堵。
lines.en: You circle the pillar; I block the far side.
Wherever you run, iron flies.
I press in from your flank.

lines.zh: 我每挪一格，嗡声就更响。
lines.en: Each block I advance, the hum grows louder.
Your sword gets a tug.
I catch your arrowheads.
I reassemble above you.
You have backed to an iron wall.
I keep to this distance.
My fragments orbit you.
I narrow the gap bit by bit.

lines.zh: 你听见嗡嗡声越来越近。
lines.en: The hum gets closer.

lines.zh: 我在你前后各放了一块。
lines.en: I place a piece on either side of you.

lines.zh: 你挡住一边，另一边空了。
lines.en: You guard one side; the other is open.
I am within two blocks.
I come around the wall after you.

lines.zh: 你把门关上，我吸住门框。
lines.en: You shut the door; I grip the frame.

lines.zh: 我一点点把你的路堵上。
lines.en: I block your path piece by piece.

lines.zh: 你砍碎一块，我又拼一块。
lines.en: You shatter a piece; I fit another.
I keep pulling your way.
I bring a fist down, heavy.
My iron arm sweeps across.
I hurl debris at you.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手臂往后拉。
lines.en: I grab your arm and pull.
You are slammed against the wall.
My iron claws clamp your shoulder.
The blow comes with a magnetic pull.
You block, and get pushed sliding.

lines.zh: 铁拳落处，石头裂成好几瓣。
lines.en: Where my iron fist lands, stone splits into shards.
I raise my arm for a second.
Your armor takes a dent.
I slam in from the side.
I press you against iron.
After the hit I rebuild my hand.
You are thrown several blocks.
I lift another foot.
That lands on the center of your shield.
You pull back; I stay put.
My fragments follow you.
I slowly open my fist.
A heap of iron plates appears.

lines.zh: 它们忽然拼成一个形状。
lines.en: They suddenly assemble into a shape.
A hum sounds in the magnetic field.
I rise out of the debris.
You hear metal knocking metal.
Nails fly off the wall.

lines.zh: 我开始在这片洞穴重组。
lines.en: I begin reassembling in this cavern.
My core lights first.
Every iron tool nearby moves.
My shadow appears.
I assemble in front of you.

lines.zh: 空气里嗡鸣声越来越近。
lines.en: The hum grows closer.
Fire cannot melt me; it only makes me red.

lines.zh: 我从高处坠落，砸成一堆。
lines.en: I fall from a height and shatter into a heap.

lines.zh: 水进了缝隙，我动得慢了。
lines.en: Water gets into my seams and slows me.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的壳炸开一半。
lines.en: The blast tears half my shell open.
An arrowhead lodges in my shell.

lines.zh: 那股力量打乱了我的重组。
lines.en: That force scrambles my assembly.
I have no hunger, only wear.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的壳跑了一圈。
lines.en: Lightning runs around my shell.

lines.zh: 下面空了，我的碎片往下散。
lines.en: The ground is gone; my pieces scatter down.
